closing.summary: Big strengths are carb quality, vitamin K, and omega 3, but the biggest weaknesses are low calcium, low protein quality, and contains anti-nutrients. It is good for immune support, practical meals, and low-calorie volume because vitamin C and vitamin A gives the immune-support side a reason to exist, the food-type role makes it easy to build meals around, and it can add bulk or fullness without much calorie pressure.
